About the night

Nocturne is a Halloween night built for Hyderabad after dark. Nocturne 2026 lands on 31 October: a crowd in costume, a room drowned in black light and smoke, and a night you will not want to end. Dress up, show up and lose control of the rest.

🚫No alcohol will be served.
Come for the dark, the music and the costumes.

Dress up

Costumes are the dress code. Go dark, go creepy, go unforgettable.

Customer support

Lost in the dark? Start with these answers. Still stuck? Message us on Instagram.

How do I get a pass?

Tap "Get my pass" on any page, then hit "Register" on the Early Bird card and fill in the form.

Will alcohol be served?

No. Nocturne is an alcohol-free night.

Do I need a costume?

Yes, dress up is the whole point. Bring your best Halloween look.

Where is the venue and what time does it start?

Both will be announced on our Instagram soon.

I have a problem with my pass or payment.

Send us a direct message on Instagram with your name and payment details and we will help you.
